text: Assalamu alaikum, Tariq. It’s nice to connect with you. I read in your profile that you enjoy hiking and being outdoors.
Wa alaikum assalam, Aisha. Yes, I find a lot of peace in nature. It helps me disconnect and reflect. Do you enjoy spending time outdoors as well?
I do, though I'm more of a casual walker than a hiker! I value quiet weekends with family mostly. How often do you get to see your family?
Family is very important to me too. I try to visit my parents every weekend for Sunday dinner. It's a tradition we hold onto tightly.
